n.description: int The row dimension of the arrays for which the returned indices will be valid.

k.description: int, optional Diagonal offset (see `tril` for details).

m.description: int, optional The column dimension of the arrays for which the returned arrays will be valid. By default `m` is taken equal to `n`.

output.description: ------- tuple of arrays The row and column indices, respectively. The row indices are sorted in non-decreasing order, and the corresponding column indices are strictly increasing for each row.
